However, the queue-load claim is overstated: `TopicRetriever#retrieved_recently?` throttles per-URL via `$redis.setnx` with a 60s expiry, so the enqueued jobs largely no-op. This is a genuine design/robustness gap (no terminal failure path, unvalidated embed_url flowing into job args) rather than a clearly verifiable defect

judged_text: The miss path enqueues RetrieveTopic with the raw unvalidated embed_url on every request (the only embed_url host/length validation lives inside the job) and the loading view reloads every 30 seconds, so a URL that can never be imported loops forever with no failure terminal state or negative-result caching. Readers of a misconfigured or unreachable embed see 'Loading Discussion...' indefinitely while their browsers re-enqueue a Sidekiq job every 30 seconds each — a popular page with a broken embed becomes steady job-queue load, and arbitrarily long embed_url strings flow into job args bounded only by the in-job URI parse.

Readers of a misconfigured or unreachable embed see 'Loading Discussion...' indefinitely while their browsers re-enqueue a Sidekiq job every 30 seconds each — a popular page with a broken embed becomes steady job-queue load, and arbitrarily long embed_url strings flow into job args bounded only by the in-job URI parse.

adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController#best`, when no existing embed is found it always `Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ... embed_url: embed_url)` with only `params.require(:embed_url)` as validation, then renders `loading` (which auto-reloads every 30s in `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb`). There is no controller-side throttling or negative-result caching, so an embed URL that can never be imported (misconfigured settings/unreachable URL/invalid host) will keep the user stuck on “Loading…” and re-enqueue a Sidekiq job every reload. The only guards are inside the job/retriever (`RetrieveTopic` only checks presence; `TopicRetriever` checks host and uses a 60s redis throttle *during execution*, not on enqueue), so unbounded/very long `embed_url` strings can also be pushed into job args repeatedly.
